format: Each vector lists its fields in wire order; bytes_hex is their concatenation. Integers are little-endian; an AuthoritySlot is sig_scheme(1) || pubkey(33) (00 secp256r1, 01 ed25519 32B + 00 pad, 02 webauthn compressed P-256).

vectors.name: wallet_2auth_passkey_root_pending_recovery
vectors.description: MachineWallet account data: account_tag 0x57 ('W'), 153-byte header (root = the passkey at offset 52, authority_epoch 3, pending recovery to the SE key with eta, recovery_threshold 1 at offset 136, session_nonce 11 at offset 137 and governance_nonce 17 at offset 145, independent of nonce 7), then 2 authority slots (SE Ed25519, passkey WebAuthn) = 153 + 2x34 = 221 bytes. The wallet stores no vault: vault i is PDA(machine_vault, wallet, i as u16 LE). With no pending recovery the pending slot is ff || 33 zero bytes and the eta is 0. recovery_threshold 0 means ProposeRecovery needs the spending threshold.

vectors.name: session_t_p2_sol_cash1_credit1_sleeve1_passkey_creator
vectors.description: SessionState account data: account_tag 0x54 ('T'), 112-byte header (authority_epoch 3, flags = NET_EXPOSURE, generation 19 at offset 101, vault_index 3 at offset 109: the one wallet vault the session may move, vault_bump at offset 111: that vault's canonical bump), 2 programs, then mandate_hash, creator (WebAuthn), rent_payer (the CreateSession fee payer; the only refund target on close), cash_count, 2 cash entries of 96 B (the SOL budget under the all-zero mint with 6789 cash_credit and zero principal usage, then one token mint with counters mid-period), sleeve_count, 16-entry pre-allocated non-cash sleeve (1 live, 15 zero) = size(2,2) = 1108 bytes

vectors.name: ix_rotate_root_disc17
vectors.description: RotateRoot instruction data: disc 17 | max_slot_le | new_root sig_scheme | new_root pubkey (43 bytes); accounts [instructions_sysvar, wallet(w), fee_payer(s)]

vectors.name: ix_create_session_disc4
vectors.description: CreateSession instruction data (the v1 signature binds the funds and session nonce domains, N and S): disc 4 | max_slot_le | session_authority | expiry_slot_le | vault_index_le (u16; signed in the session data hash, fixed for the session's life) | programs_count | programs | mandate_hash | creator sig_scheme | creator pubkey | flags | cash_count | cash (64 B each: mint|per_tx_cap|period_cap|period_slots|lifetime_cap; exactly one entry, required, uses the all-zero SOL mint); accounts [instructions_sysvar, wallet(w), fee_payer(s), session(w), system_program]

vectors.name: ix_propose_recovery_disc20
vectors.description: ProposeRecovery instruction data: disc 20 | max_slot_le | new_root sig_scheme | new_root pubkey (43 bytes); signed by the wallet's recovery threshold (recovery_threshold, or the spending threshold when 0) over machine_wallet_propose_recovery_v1 and governance_nonce; rejected with 77 (RecoveryAlreadyPending) while a proposal is pending, and consumes no counter; accounts [instructions_sysvar, wallet(w), fee_payer(s)]

vectors.name: ix_cancel_recovery_disc21
vectors.description: CancelRecovery instruction data: disc 21 | max_slot_le (9 bytes); root-signed over machine_wallet_cancel_recovery_v1; accounts [instructions_sysvar, wallet(w), fee_payer(s)]

vectors.name: ix_execute_recovery_disc22
vectors.description: ExecuteRecovery instruction data: disc 22 | max_slot_le (9 bytes); signed by the pending root over machine_wallet_execute_recovery_v1 (payload binds the pending root slot); moves the root, removes the old root key and clamps threshold / recovery_threshold to the remaining count; accounts [instructions_sysvar, wallet(w), fee_payer(s)]

vectors.name: ix_bump_epoch_disc23
vectors.description: BumpEpoch instruction data: disc 23 | max_slot_le (9 bytes); signed by any one current authority over wallet session_nonce using machine_wallet_bump_epoch_v1; advances session_nonce and authority_epoch, leaving the spending nonce unchanged; accounts [instructions_sysvar, wallet(w), fee_payer(s)]

vectors.name: ix_set_recovery_threshold_disc24
vectors.description: SetRecoveryThreshold instruction data: disc 24 | recovery_threshold | max_slot_le (10 bytes); signed by the root AND the threshold over machine_wallet_set_recovery_threshold_v1; 0 = follow the spending threshold, else 1..=authority_count; accounts [instructions_sysvar, wallet(w), fee_payer(s)]

vectors.name: vault_pda_index_3
vectors.description: Vault 3 of a wallet: wallet | vault_index_le | vault, where vault = find_program_address([machine_vault, wallet, vault_index as u16 LE], program_id) with the canonical bump. Vault 0 is the owner's main account; every index is governed by the wallet's one authority set.

vectors.name: ix_execute_disc1
vectors.description: Execute instruction data: disc 1 | max_slot_le | vault_index_le (u16; the vault the inner instructions run as, signed into the execute message) | inner_count_u32 | inner instructions (program_id | accounts_len_u16 | data_len_u16 | (index, flags) pairs | data). Disc 16 inserts num_ephemeral | bumps after vault_index. Accounts [instructions_sysvar, wallet(w), fee_payer(s), vault(w), remaining...]. Example: vault 3, one instruction, one writable account, two data bytes.

vectors.name: ix_execute_bounded_disc25
vectors.description: ExecuteBounded instruction data: disc 25 | max_slot_le | vault_index_le | bound_count_u8 (<= 8) | bounds (mint 32 | kind u8 | amount_le u64) | inner_count_u32 | inner instructions as in Execute. A bound is the least net change the call may leave in the vault's balance of that mint over all its token accounts: kind 0 = may fall by at most amount, kind 1 = must rise by at least amount. The all-zero mint is SOL (vault lamports plus its token accounts' lamports; wrapped SOL counts as SOL). A mint with no bound may not fall; a mint named twice or a kind above 1 is rejected. Signed over machine_wallet_execute_bounded_v1 with bound_count | bounds between vault_index and inner_hash. Fails with 78 (BalanceBoundViolated), or 69 / 74 when the call hands out or touches vault authority. Accounts as in Execute. Example: vault 3, at most 5000 of mint 0x33.. out, at least 7 lamports in.

vectors.name: ix_session_execute_disc5
vectors.description: SessionExecute: disc 5 | generation_le | bound_count_u8 | bound_count x (mint 32 | kind u8 | amount_le u64) | inner_count_u32 | inner instructions. The outer session-key signature binds generation 19 and the bounds before any CPI. The bounds section is the one in ix_execute_bounded_disc25, with the same meaning. Example: at most 1,000,000 of mint c1.. out, at least 5,000,000 lamports (the all-zero mint) in; one instruction, one writable account, two data bytes.

vectors.name: ix_self_revoke_session_disc7
vectors.description: SelfRevokeSession: disc 7 | generation_le (9 bytes); session-key signed, rejects another generation before changing revoked.

vectors.name: ix_close_session_disc8
vectors.description: CloseSession: disc 8 | generation_le (9 bytes); session-key signed, matches generation and requires expired or revoked, refunds recorded rent payer.
